name: SAIC Early College Program Summer Institute (ECPSI)
org: School of the Art Institute of Chicago
what_you_do: Intensive 1, 2 or 4-week summer art and design courses at SAIC. Students earn one college credit for each week attended.
who_can_apply: High school students ages 15 to 18 who have completed their sophomore year by the time of the program. Merit scholarships are open to all students; need-based aid is for US residents.
pay_detail: Tuition is $1,982 for 1 week, $3,964 for 2 weeks and $7,928 for 4 weeks. Housing and meal plan rates for 2027 are still being finalized, estimated at $675 a week, and are required for students living on campus. The page also lists supplies and personal spending. A $100 non-refundable tuition deposit applies to students who apply for aid or scholarships. Merit scholarships and limited need-based aid (US residents) are offered.
duration: 1, 2 or 4 weeks. 2027 sessions run June 14 to July 30.
deadline_text: Registration for the 2027 sessions began November 1, and course pages show Add to cart. The Session 1 course page lists a registration deadline of Monday, June 7 at 11:59 PM; check each course page for its own date. Merit scholarship and need-based aid applications are due March 1, and full payment is due May 1 (no year printed).
how_to_apply: Pick a course and session at the registration link and sign up online. When you sign up, you can also apply for a merit scholarship or need-based aid by choosing the $100 option.
notes: The program page still reads 'Registration Opens November 1!' with no year, but the 2027 course pages show working Add to cart buttons (checked 2026-11-02). No single closing date covers all sessions. An online version (ECPOSI) has its own course list.
